content.overview: Part IV (Articles 36–51) embodies the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP), establishing India’s vision of a socio-economic welfare state. While non-justiciable under Article 37, they are fundamental in the governance of the country. Minerva Mills (1980) settled that the balance between Part III and Part IV is an inviolable feature of the Basic Structure.
